title: Awesome  bus & walking tours
text:
Great Experience and Excellent Value!

We really enjoyed the 48-hour hop-on hop-off bus tour and the free walking tours included in the ticket. The buses are modern and comfortable, the stops are conveniently located, and the staff are friendly and helpful. The multilingual audio guides are also great.

Special thanks to Claudio and Belén for their fantastic walking tours! A fun and informative way to explore Seville. Highly recommended and definitely worth the money!

title: Guadalquivir cruise + 2 walking tours.
text:
I liked it a lot; besides, it was hot, but on the boat we were able to enjoy a pleasant breeze while they explained the bridges and tourist sites to you.
Advice: do it after eating so you are relaxed and sitting down while you continue sightseeing. They also gifted us 2 very informative and pleasant walking tours; we had a guide named Claudio who is very nice.
author: G2059NSmariac

title: The guides are the best
text: The guided tours through the neighborhoods of Sta. were very pleasant. Cruz and Triana with Claudio. A very pleasant, helpful, and dynamic guy. He told us very curious things about different key points. Also, the girls who assisted me both at the Torre del Oro stand and at the meeting point were both super pleasant and provided me with a lot of information. The boat trip is recommended to be done late in the afternoon. The bus could perhaps have more stops, but well, nothing else worth noting.

title: Walking tour 10/10
text: The guide Claudio from the walking tour of the Santa Cruz and Triana neighborhoods was a real sweetheart, who explained everything with dedication and charm. Very kind, 10/10. Totally recommended

title: Seville tour bus
text:
We booked on the first day in Seville as we met Victor at the local bar, he gave us lots of good tips and advice for our stay in Seville, anyone else travelling should look up Victor at Bar doro near the bull ring
The bus was very good, good tour and easy to hop on and off when we needed

title: Highly recommended!!!!
text:
The tour on the tourist bus in Seville was a very nice experience. It covers the most interesting places in the city and allows you to get to know Seville in a very comfortable and pleasant way.
Additionally, we want to highlight Angela for her kindness and friendliness. She explained everything very clearly and gave us very useful advice that helped us a lot during our visit. Thanks to her, the tour was even more interesting and we enjoyed the experience immensely. We would give it 10 stars!⭐️

title: Nice tour, clear audioguide, varied and surprising.
text: With the tour of Seville you get a nice view of the city with its different neighborhoods and cultures. It is definitely worth doing this tour.
author: GrandTour03995384464

title: Great introduction to Sevilla
text: Great way to become familiar with the city without getting tired walking. Tour takes around an hour with 14 hop on and off locations. The second floor of the bus had a shaded area where you could get an unobstructed view.  The pass was good for 48 hours so it is easy to go back and see areas in more detail
